purpose: Proposed syntactic SELECT table-declaration repair; production is unchanged until native application in the future full gate.
invariants: A qualified name tail is an operand even when its spelling is a bare expression keyword.
Only SELECT-owned FROM lists seed table declaration exclusions.
Relation and function arguments, ON and USING operands, and derived query bodies remain visible.
Only relation heads, aliases and their column declaration lists are excluded.
Balanced arrays keep their commas out of sibling table-factor traversal.
Nested parenthesized table walks use shorter prefix slices and retain original token indices.
limitations: This remains a syntactic-presence guard, not reference-to-table binding.
No compiler, catalog resolution, CTE header, non-PostgreSQL, or write-target scan change.
